subject: Hosted API feasibility, endpoints and rate-limit check — FinBot pilot
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Ellie Turner <ellie.turner@finbot.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-30T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Hosted API feasibility, endpoints and rate-limit check — FinBot pilot

Hi Ellie — great to meet today, thanks for the demo. Quick recap from our call and a few operational questions so we can size the right onramp (Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private):

Key notes from demo:
- Primary workload: real-time financial assistant for advisors (short prompts + structured outputs; most responses ~150–400 tokens).
- Peak concurrency: rough estimate ~200–300 concurrent active users at end of Q1; baseline steady-state ~40–60 qps for text-gen.
- Latency sensitivity: interactive UI target p95 < 400ms for <512 tokens.
- Data concerns: some prompts include customer identifiers; no PHI. You noted a residency preference for US only.

Questions to confirm (so we can propose a clean evaluation path):
1) Can you confirm expected sustained qps and projected peak qps during campaigns? (ballpark is fine)
2) Typical request/response token budget (prompt + response) — we heard 500–700 tokens on average, correct?
3) Do you need streaming chunked responses in the initial eval?
4) Any policy/regulatory blockers for sending data to our hosted environment (e.g., contractual data residency, encryption requirements)?

Recommended next steps from Redwood to validate Hosted fit (we'll propose Dedicated/Private only if constraints require it):
- Pilot smoke test: 48–72 hour run against your traffic profile (we provide a test key and two endpoints: /v1/chat for chat flows, /v1/generate for batch/rerank).
- Quickstart: our attached one-pager + step-by-step checklist (see redwood_quickstart-guide.pdf).
- Ops sync: 30m call with Jordan (runtime/limits) and Marcus (security/compliance) to confirm rate caps and RBAC.

If you can answer the 4 questions above, I’ll send a tailored smoke-test plan and a temporary API key with suggested rate limits.

Attachments: redwood_quickstart-guide.pdf (quickstart checklist)

Thanks — Neha
Neha Kapoor
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0199

Redwood Inference — Make inference predictable and economical
From: Ellie Turner <ellie.turner@finbot.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@finbot.ai>
Date: 2026-10-01T09:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API feasibility, endpoints and rate-limit check — FinBot pilot

Thanks Neha — good summary and feel free to loop Samir (our infra lead). Answers inline: 

1) Sustained qps: baseline 50–70 qps. Peak during marketing pushes ~350 qps for ~30–60 minutes.
2) Tokens: average observed is ~450 tokens (prompt+response). Peak responses can go up to ~1,200 tokens for some batch/rerank jobs but those are <5% of traffic.
3) Streaming: yes, we'd like to test streaming for the advisor UI (progressive response display).
4) Data residency: must remain in US regions for now; contractually we need SOC2 evidence and a list of encryption-at-rest options. No requirement for on-prem at this stage.

We are inclined to start in Hosted for speed, but if rate caps or residency limit throughput we may ask about Dedicated.

Can you include estimated cost cadence for the smoke test (tokens + outbound)? Also, Samir would like to see rate-limit options so we can plan throttling on our side.

—Ellie
Ellie Turner
Head of Product, FinBot
ellie.turner@finbot.ai | +1 (650) 555-0123

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Ellie Turner <ellie.turner@finbot.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API feasibility, endpoints and rate-limit check — FinBot pilot

On Thu, Oct 1, 2026 at 9:42 AM, Ellie Turner <ellie.turner@finbot.ai> wrote:
> 1) Sustained qps: baseline 50–70 qps. Peak during marketing pushes ~350 qps for ~30–60 minutes.
> 2) Tokens: average observed is ~450 tokens (prompt+response). Peak responses can go up to ~1,200 tokens for some batch/rerank jobs but those are <5% of traffic.
> 3) Streaming: yes, we'd like to test streaming for the advisor UI (progressive response display).
> 4) Data residency: must remain in US regions for now; contractually we need SOC2 evidence and a list of encryption-at-rest options.

Thanks for the details — that's helpful and aligns with a Hosted pilot. Operational comments and proposals: 

- Endpoints: use /v1/chat for the interactive advisor flows (streaming enabled) and /v1/generate for bulk rerank/batch jobs.
- Rate-limit proposal (initial smoke test):
  * Default smoke key: 100 qps burstable to 350 qps for sustained 1-hour windows (we can throttle by token-rate as well).
  * Token budget: cap tokens per request at 2,000 during smoke to avoid runaway costs; we'll surface analytics per token-class.
- Latency: we will route to US-west region by default; expected p95 for your token profile is ~250–450ms on our hosted tier. We'll instrument traces for the pilot.
- Security artifacts: attaching our quickstart (redwood_quickstart-guide.pdf) and SLA-options.xlsx. For SOC2, Marcus will share the SOC2 attestation link and encryption options in the ops sync.

Costs: for the 48-hour smoke with the profile you shared (estimated 100k tokens/hour average), rough hosted estimate is $1,800–$2,400 (depends on model choice + streaming overhead). We'll refine once you pick model & token mix.

Next steps I propose: 
- I’ll create a smoke-test plan and temporary API keys once we confirm a kickoff slot.
- Jordan — can you confirm the token-based throttling knobs and whether we should enable prefix caching for FinBot’s common prompts?
- Ellie/Samir — can you share a small sample prompt set (10–20 examples) we can use for quality checks and to tune batch size?

Available slots for a 30m ops sync: Oct 2 at 10:00am PT, Oct 2 at 3:00pm PT, Oct 5 at 8:30am PT. Which works best?

Thanks — Neha
Neha Kapoor
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0199

Attachments: redwood_quickstart-guide.pdf, SLA-options.xlsx

Thanks — Oct 2 at 10:00am PT works for Samir and me. We can supply the sample prompts before EOD today (I'll attach them to the HubSpot deal).

We'd like the smoke test to specifically exercise streaming and a short rerank job. For credentials, please issue a read-only test key limited to the smoke traffic profile. Also, confirm the dashboard we'll use for token/latency visibility (is there a shared link?).

I'll also add a note in the deal (HubSpot) with our legal contact for SOC2 docs; Samir will be on the sync to review encryption options.

Look forward to the test — Ellie
